# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c26 P11](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette Pullen almost fell into the water while reaching out to gather water lilies. She is described as having a sensible demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000)_

## Personality

Odette is very sensible, hardworking, and dutiful. She is not overly romantic or dramatic, though she wept more than anyone else during Mr. Pidgeon's farewell speech despite insisting she wouldn't. She is practical about her future, choosing to pursue teaching as a means of earning her own income.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

- to train as a teacher and dedicate her life to pedagogy to earn an independent income  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette attended the Sunday-school picnic at Pembroke's pond, where she nearly fell into the water reaching for lilies before being saved by her father. She participated in school activities at Brierley, including singing, field days, and the story club, where she wrote very sensible stories lacking romance. She performed in the school concert as the Fairy Queen in 'The Fairy Queen' dialogue. After joining the Regent's entrance class under Miss Thorne, she studied diligently and successfully passed her entrance examinations, earning top marks in domestic science at Regent's. Upon completing her studies, she was offered a teaching position at the school in Stonebridge.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_

## Background by volume

- her father is considered stingy and an old eccentric in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- she has a brother named Barney and sisters named Mattie and Alice  <sub>[v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P76](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0076), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
